pages.title: Auth — token refresh
pages.summary: Refresh tokens rotate on every use; access tokens last 1 hour. Hourly logouts were a race between tabs, fixed on 2026-09-17 with a BroadcastChannel lock; a 10 second server grace window is pending.

pages.title: Deploy — staging
pages.summary: Staging deploys run from main. Large indexes must be built with CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY after migration 0042 timed out.

pages.title: Integrations — vendor API
pages.summary: Vendor allows 600 requests per minute per key; our client is capped at 500. Webhooks are retried 5 times.
